subject.title: build(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: After the four guard assertions are repaired, should the security-sensitive CodeQL, app-token, registry, release, and Codex-agent upgrades remain grouped with the other action bumps?
rationale: These action families execute with security-scanning, credential-minting, publishing, or agent privileges, so their grouping and rollback scope require explicit owner intent even though the proposed commits resolve to verified upstream releases.

options.title: Keep the grouped update
options.body: Repair every guard, verify exact-head checks, and approve the immutable action pins together after security-owner review.

options.title: Split privileged families
options.body: Move the security-sensitive action families into narrower owner-reviewed PRs for separate rollback scope.

recommendation.title: Keep the grouped update
recommendation.body: Repair every guard, verify exact-head checks, and approve the immutable action pins together after security-owner review.

likelyOwner.reason: This account is the strongest individual workflow-history and CODEOWNERS routing candidate; the security-specific owner is a team rather than an individual.
